traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Gisekiaceae: leaves whorled or opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; blades linear; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; stamens 5 to 15; carpels 3 to 5. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
